defs.def: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced, stronger, etc; to make sth do this （使）成长，发展，壮大

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界里，而我们的大脑形成了一种对这些零食的响应机制，反映出它们的价值——一种奖励和满足感。

ex.s: Learning how science develops.
ex.t: 了解科学如何发展。

ex.s: Such a playful approach could fuel their creativity for composition, if the student looks for ways to develop those wrong notes into something more attractive.
ex.t: 如果学生想方设法将这些错误的音符发展成更吸引人的东西，那么这种有趣的做法可以激发他们对构成的创造力。

ex.s: People develop countless habits as they explore the world, whether they are aware of them or not.
ex.t: 人们在探索世界的过程中养成无数的习惯，无论他们是否意识到这一点。

ex.s: As technology develops, young people are writing more than they ever have.
ex.t: 随着科技的发展，年轻人写的字比以往任何时候都多。

ex.s: It is different from traditional tourism because it allows the traveler to become 61 (educate) about the areas - both in terms of geographical conditions and cultural characteristics, and often provides money for conservation and benefits the 62 (develop) of the local areas.
ex.t: 它不同于传统旅游，因为它让旅行者受到____61（educate）关于该地区——无论是地理条件还是文化特征，并且常常为保护提供资金，造福当地的____62（develop）。

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今，他的爱好已发展成一个网站 postcrossing.com——一个社交网络，自他十年前创建以来，已发展到214个国家和地区的575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: A closer bond developed with the readers.
ex.t: 与读者建立起了更紧密的联系。

ex.s: Fingerprint scanning techniques develop fast.
ex.t: 指纹扫描技术发展迅速。

ex.s: Rock music developed in the 1950s and the early 1960s.
ex.t: 摇滚音乐发展于20世纪50年代和60年代早期。

ex.s: They developed very fast.
ex.t: 它们发展得非常快。

ex.s: But not all cities develop slowly over a long period of time.
ex.t: 但并非所有城市都在很长一段时间内缓慢发展。

ex.s: In fact, tradition also refers to the things that have been developing and that are still being created,” he said.
ex.t: "事实上，传统也指那些一直在发展、仍在被创造的事物，"他说。

ex.s: likely to develop unpleasant habits
ex.t: C．可能养成坏习惯

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

ex.s: As for the USA, it is almost unique among developed nations in having a population that is expected to grow by 20% from 2010—2030.
ex.t: 至于美国，在发达国家中它几乎独一无二，其人口预计在2010至2030年间增长20%。

ex.s: The word “pineapple” developed from the Spanish word “pina”, which means pine cone.
ex.t: 英语单词pineapple是从西班牙语单词pina发展而来的，意思是松果。

ex.s: The music industry is developing fast now.
ex.t: 音乐产业现在发展迅速。

ex.s: With good eating habits, you will be able to get the energy and nutrients you need to allow your body to grow and develop properly.
ex.t: 有了良好的饮食习惯，您将能够获得让身体正常生长和发育所需的能量和营养。

ex.s: Our formative environment as a species was information-poor, so our brains developed a mechanism that prized new information.
ex.t: 作为人类，我们形成期的环境是信息匮乏的，因此我们的大脑形成了一种重视新信息的机制。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

ex.s: You might think that developing nations would make up the loss (especially since 80% of the world’s people now live in such nations), but you’d be wrong.
ex.t: 你可能以为发展中国家会弥补这一损失（特别是既然世界上80%的人现在生活在这样的国家），但你错了。

ex.s: If you do, you won’ be able to   59   it and the whole thing develops into an unpleasant scene and that   60   everyone’s day.
ex.t: 如果你那样做，你将无法___59___，整件事会演变成不愉快的场面，从而___60___大家的一天。

ex.s: Psychologist Susan Levine, an expert on mathematics development in young children the University of Chicago, found children who play with puzzles between ages 2 and 4 later develop better spatial skills.
ex.t: 芝加哥大学儿童数学发展专家、心理学家苏珊·莱文发现，在2到4岁之间玩拼图的孩子，日后会发展出更好的空间技能。

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

ex.s: Developed by two doctors in the US Department of Agriculture, it’s an excellent water collector.
ex.t: 而且由于回收钢铁的过程比制造新钢铁污染更少，我们还取得了以下显著的节约：能源使用——47%至74%；空气污染——85%；水污染——35%；用水量——40%。

ex.s: Develop broad, general knowledge and experience.
ex.t: 发展广博的一般知识和经验。

ex.s: Join us as a volunteer manager to develop your own skills while bringing benefits to the communities.
ex.t: 加入我们成为志愿者经理，在为他人带来益处的同时发展自己的技能。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

defs.def: to think of or produce a new idea, product, etc. and make it successful 开发；研制

ex.s: That might mean either developing a uniform way to mark videos and images, showing when and who they were made by. or abandoning phone calls altogether and moving towards data-based communications—using apps like Face Time or WhatsApp, which can be tied to your identity.
ex.t: 这可能意味着要么开发一种统一的方式来标记视频和图像，显示它们何时以及由谁制作，要么完全放弃电话，转向使用基于数据的通信应用程序，如Face Time或WhatsApp ，这些应用程序可以与您的身份相关联。

ex.s: The human brain has potential yet to be developed.
ex.t: 人类大脑有待开发的潜力。

ex.s: Museums are working together with AI ethicists to develop fair algorithms.
ex.t: 博物馆正与人工智能伦理学家合作，开发公平的算法。

ex.s: ·Community Booster: Guiding you to develop innovative solutions for real-world challenges and create transformative progress to benefit all communities
ex.t: 社区助推器：引导你为现实世界的挑战开发创新解决方案，创造变革性进步以造福所有社区。

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: When I decided to pursue a postgraduate degree, I wanted to develop a novel research programme and quickly establish myself as an independent scientist.
ex.t: 当我决定攻读研究生学位时，我想开发一个新颖的研究项目，并迅速确立自己作为独立科学家的地位。

ex.s: With help from Tesla, Westinghouse's firm developed a system using alternating current, which soon became the major forms of power delivery.
ex.t: 在特斯拉的帮助下，Westinghouse 的公司开发了一种使用交流电的系统，很快成为电力输送的主要形式。

ex.s: The engineers are also trying to develop an on and off＂switch＂where the glow would fade when exposed to daylight.
ex.t: 工程师们还在尝试开发一种开关，使植物在日光照射下光芒变暗。

ex.s: Why do the researchers develop the smart keyboard?
ex.t: 研究人员为什么要开发智能键盘？

ex.s: The Texas-based company has developed and patented scooping and lifting technology to move massive trees.
ex.t: "我[已经]为此失去了足够的睡眠，"该公司西部副总裁大卫·考克斯说——那还是在医院提到这棵树的显赫出身之前。

ex.s: Led by Professor Phil Blythe, the Newcastle team are developing in-vehicle technologies for older drivers which they hope could help them to continue driving into later life.
ex.t: 在菲尔·布莱斯教授的领导下，纽卡斯尔团队正在为老年驾驶员开发车载技术，他们希望这些技术能帮助他们在晚年继续驾驶。

ex.s: Develop driver-assist technologles.
ex.t: 开发驾驶辅助技术。

ex.s: To develop low-maintenance parkland.
ex.t: 开发低维护的公园用地。

ex.s: To develop new wildlife parks.
ex.t: 开发新的野生动物园。

defs.def: to begin to have sth such as a disease or a problem; to start to affect sb/sth 患（病）；出现（问题）；（疾病）开始侵袭；（问题）开始影响

ex.s: With human inputs dramatically reduced, the garden’s ecology can develop well.
ex.t: 在人类中，高度发达的大脑增强了自律能力，正如它增强了在社交和物理世界中的解决问题能力一样。

ex.s: Five percent of the highly fit women developed dementia, compared to 25 percent of the women with medium fitness and 32 percent of the women with low fitness.
ex.t: 5%的高度健康女性患上痴呆症，相比之下中等健康女性为25%，低健康女性为32%。

ex.s: Fit Women Are Less Likely to Develop Dementia
ex.t: 健康的女性更不容易患痴呆症

ex.s: Her monitor has shown that air pollution levels are higher closer to ground level, which has helped highlight concerns that babies and young kids may be at higher risk of developing lung problems.
ex.t: 她的监测器显示，越靠近地面，空气污染水平越高，这凸显了人们对婴儿和幼儿可能面临更高患肺病风险的担忧。

ex.s: Developing a serious mental disease.
ex.t: 患上了严重的精神疾病。

ex.s: Carducci believes developing such a sense of belonging starts with small talk.
ex.t: Carducci 认为，培养这种归属感始于闲聊。

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

ex.s: They have transformed themselves into places where you can develop your love of knowledge meet interesting people, or find out how to start a business.
ex.t: 它们已经把自己转变成了这样的地方：你可以在这里培养对知识的热爱、结识有趣的人，或者了解如何创业。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

ex.s: During that time, 44 of the women developed dementia.
ex.t: 在那段时间里，44名女性患上了痴呆症。

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健硕的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性低近90%，而且即使患病，也比不爱运动的女性晚十年发作。

defs.def: to start to happen or change, especially in a bad way （尤指开始向坏的方面）发展，变化

ex.s: The coming technological advancement presents a chance for cities and states to develop transportation systems designed to move more people, and more affordably.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和各州提供了发展交通系统的机会，这些交通系统旨在以更廉价的方式迁移更多的人。

ex.s: These abilities are strengthened by our capacity for language, which allows social practices to develop in extremely unobvious ways.
ex.t: 这些能力因我们的语言能力而加强，语言能力让社会实践能以极其不明显的方式发展。

ex.s: Then you let these new systems develop their own ways to self-repair.”
ex.t: 然后你让这些新系统发展出自我修复的方式。”

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: Not only will you help our young volunteers to develop personally，you'll also learn new skills and increase your cultural awareness.
ex.t: 你不仅能帮助我们年轻的志愿者个人成长，还能学到新技能并提高文化意识。

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对克鲁斯来说，最初打发时间的方式，如今已变成在孩子心灵中产生积极影响的方式。

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为激素的身体化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年身体发育出成人特征，还让他们在晚上11点前难以入睡。

ex.s: An Australian professor is developing a robot to monitor the health of grazing cattle, a development that could bring big changes to a profession that's relied largely on a low-tech approach for decades but is facing a labor shortage.
ex.t: 一位澳大利亚教授正在开发一种机器人，用于监测放牧牛群的健康，这一进展可能给一个几十年来主要依赖低技术手段、正面临劳动力短缺的行业带来巨大变化。

ex.s: Ways to develop reading ability.
ex.t: 培养阅读能力的方法。

defs.def: to start to have a skill, ability, quality, etc. that becomes better and stronger; to become better and stronger 加强；增强；发挥

ex.s: Help kids develop analytical skills.
ex.t: 帮助孩子培养分析能力。

ex.s: Allow them to lead discussions and meetings to develop their communication skills.
ex.t: 让他们主导讨论和会议，以培养他们的沟通技能。

ex.s: They help develop advanced skills.
ex.t: 它们有助于培养高级技能。

ex.t: 除了烹饪，你还想培养哪些其他生活技能？

ex.s: The program aims to help students develop science skills, environmental awareness, and healthy lifestyles.
ex.t: 该项目旨在帮助学生培养科学技能、环境意识和健康的生活方式。

ex.s: You’ll develop that painting muscle memory that only comes with repetition.
ex.t: 你会形成那种只有通过重复才能获得的绘画肌肉记忆。

ex.t: Young 女士早年培养了对烹饪的热情。

ex.s: develop a passion for learning
ex.t: B．培养对学习的热情

ex.t: Pennington 做了什么来帮助 Benjamin 发挥他的才华？

ex.t: 这能锻炼你的核心肌肉，强化你的下背部。

ex.s: He developed a talent for football by kicking a ball made of rubbish around the streets.
ex.t: 他在街头踢用垃圾做成的球，练就了足球天赋。

ex.s: In the study, about 52 percent of the dads exhibited above-average levels of authoritative parenting. key finding is that over time, children raised by an authoritative father were significantly more likely to develop persistence, which leads to better outcomes in school.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿方式。关键发现是，随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养的孩子明显更有可能培养出毅力，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

ex.s: her eagerness to develop her reading ability
ex.t: B．她急于培养自己的阅读能力。

defs.def: to build new houses, factories, etc. on an area of land, especially land that was not being used effectively before 修建；开发

ex.s: The mechanism involves a repurposed reward system originally used to develop habits important for self-care.
ex.t: 这一机制涉及一种被重新利用的奖励系统，该系统原本用于培养对自我照顾很重要的习惯。

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 未来，该团队希望开发一种技术版本，可以一次性喷洒到植物叶片上，效果持续植物一生。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: The researchers believe that the findings could help technology companies develop better machines that use air to do their jobs, as suction has long been used in robotics to grab objects.
ex.t: 研究人员认为这些发现可以帮助技术公司开发更好的利用空气工作的机器，因为吸力长期以来一直被用于机器人技术来抓取物体。

ex.s: One thing I had developed an interest in was sewing, so I took a sewing course at a community college.
ex.t: 我培养出的一项兴趣是缝纫，于是我在社区大学报了一门缝纫课。

defs.def: to make an idea, a story, etc. clearer by explaining it further 详尽阐述；阐明

ex.s: To develop the theme.
ex.t: 展开主题。

ex.s: “Sleep is the price we pay for learning,” says Giulio Tononi, who developed the idea.
ex.t: "睡眠是我们为学习付出的代价，"提出这一理念的朱利奥·托诺尼说。

ex.s: Old habits can be difficult to shake, and healthy habits are often harder to develop.
ex.t: 旧习惯可能很难改掉，而健康习惯往往更难养成。

ex.t: 她养成了坚强的个性。
